intake.title: My symptoms
intake.intro: Describe your symptoms – in your own language. Your therapist will read it before the treatment.
intake.where_hint: Tap the places on the body (several are possible). Switch with “Front/Back”.
intake.goals: What would you like to be able to do again?

goal_opt.overhead: raise my arm above my head

intake.text_hint: Write or speak in your own language. It will be translated for the practice.
intake.text_ph: What happened? What makes it worse or better?
intake.emergency: If the pain is severe or suddenly new, contact your doctor. In an emergency, call 144.
intake.privacy: Your answers stay on the practice's server.
intake.sent_flash: Thank you! The practice has received your answers.
intake.text_hint_same: Describe in your own words what is bothering you. You can write or speak.
